```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(tidymodels)
library(janitor)
library(baguette)
library(ranger)
```

# EDA from hw9

```{r}
bike_data <- read_csv("https://www4.stat.ncsu.edu/~online/datasets/SeoulBikeData.csv", locale = locale(encoding = "latin1"))

bike_data_clean <- bike_data %>% mutate(Date = dmy(Date)) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.character), as.factor)) %>%
  clean_names() %>%
  # Dont like some of the names
  rename("temperature" = "temperature_c",
         "wind_speed" = "wind_speed_m_s",
         "visibility" = "visibility_10m",
         "dew_point_temperature" = "dew_point_temperature_c",
         "solar_radiation" = "solar_radiation_mj_m2",
         "rainfall" = "rainfall_mm",
         "snowfall" = "snowfall_cm")

bike_data_final <- bike_data_clean %>%
  group_by(date, seasons, holiday) %>%
  # Subsetting function == Yes
  filter(functioning_day == "Yes") %>%
  summarize(
    # Totals for bikes and precip
    total_rented_bike_count = sum(rented_bike_count, na.rm = TRUE),
    total_rainfall = sum(rainfall, na.rm = TRUE),
    total_snowfall = sum(snowfall, na.rm = TRUE),
    
    # Means for weather
    across(c(temperature,
        humidity_percent,
        wind_speed,
        visibility,
        dew_point_temperature,
        solar_radiation,
      ),
      ~ mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE),
      .names = "mean_{.col}"
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

# Splitting for MLR, and doing 10 fold

```{r}
set.seed(9524)
bike_split <- rsample::initial_split(bike_data_final, prop = 0.75, strata = seasons)
bike_train <- training(bike_split)
bike_test <- testing(bike_split)

bike_10_fold <- vfold_cv(bike_train, 10)
```

# Fitting some MLR models

Engine
```{r}
bike_mod <- linear_reg() %>% set_engine("lm")
```


## Recipe 1 and workflow

```{r}
bike_rec1 <- recipe(total_rented_bike_count ~ ., data = bike_train) %>%
  step_date(date, features = c("dow")) %>%
  step_mutate(day_type = factor(if_else(date_dow  %in% c("Sat","Sun"), "weekend", "weekday" ))) %>%
  step_rm(date) %>%
  step_dummy(seasons, holiday, day_type) %>%
  step_normalize(all_numeric(), -all_outcomes())

```

## Recipe 2

```{r}
bike_rec2 <- bike_rec1 %>% step_interact(terms = ~ starts_with("seasons_"):starts_with("holiday_")) %>%
  step_interact(terms = ~ starts_with("seasons_"):mean_temperature) %>%
  step_interact(terms = ~ mean_temperature:total_rainfall)
```


## Recipe 3

```{r}
bike_rec3 <- bike_rec2 %>% step_mutate(temp_sq = mean_temperature^2,
                                       humidity_sq = mean_humidity_percent^2)
```

## Fitting the models

```{r}
bike_CV_fits1 <- workflow() %>% add_recipe(bike_rec1) %>%
  add_model(bike_mod) %>%
  fit_resamples(bike_10_fold)

bike_CV_fits2 <- workflow() %>% add_recipe(bike_rec2) %>%
  add_model(bike_mod) %>%
  fit_resamples(bike_10_fold)

bike_CV_fits3 <- workflow() %>% add_recipe(bike_rec3) %>%
  add_model(bike_mod) %>%
  fit_resamples(bike_10_fold)
```

Getting the metrics

```{r}
rbind(bike_CV_fits1 |> collect_metrics(),
      bike_CV_fits2 |> collect_metrics(),
      bike_CV_fits3 |> collect_metrics())
```
Model1 looks the best as it has the lowest rmse (4189.7715963)


## Best mlr fit to entire training data

```{r}
mlr_final <- workflow() %>% add_recipe(bike_rec1) %>%
  add_model(bike_mod) %>%
  last_fit(bike_split, metrics = metric_set(rmse, mae))
```


# Fitting other models using recipe 1

## Reg tree

Workflow for tree

```{r}
tree_mod <- decision_tree(tree_depth = tune(),
                          min_n = 20,
                          cost_complexity = tune()) %>%
  set_engine("rpart") %>%
  set_mode("regression")

tree_wkf <- workflow() %>% add_recipe(bike_rec1) %>%
  add_model(tree_mod)
```

Fit workflow on folds

```{r}
tree_grid <- grid_regular(cost_complexity(),
                          tree_depth(),
                          levels = c(10, 5))
tree_fits <- tree_wkf %>% 
  tune_grid(resamples = bike_10_fold,
            grid = tree_grid)

tree_best_params <- select_best(tree_fits, metric = "rmse")

tree_final_wkf <- tree_wkf %>% finalize_workflow(tree_best_params)

tree_final_fit <- tree_final_wkf %>% last_fit(bike_split, metrics = metric_set(rmse, mae))
```


## Bag tree

Workflow for bagged tree

```{r}
bag_spec <- bag_tree(tree_depth = 5, min_n = 10, cost_complexity = tune()) %>% 
  set_engine("rpart") %>%
  set_mode("regression")

bag_wkf <- workflow() %>% add_recipe(bike_rec1) %>% 
  add_model(bag_spec)
```

Fit workflow on folds

```{r}
bag_fit <- bag_wkf %>% tune_grid(resamples = bike_10_fold, 
                                 grid = grid_regular(cost_complexity(),levels = 15))

bag_best_params <- select_best(bag_fit, metric = "rmse")

bag_final_wkf <- bag_wkf %>% finalize_workflow(bag_best_params)
bag_final_fit <- bag_final_wkf %>% last_fit(bike_split, metrics = metric_set(rmse, mae))
```

## Random Forest

Workflow for random forest

```{r}
rf_spec <- rand_forest(mtry = tune()) %>% 
  set_engine("ranger", importance = "impurity") %>%
  set_mode("regression")

rf_wkf <- workflow() %>% 
  add_recipe(bike_rec1) %>%
  add_model(rf_spec)
```

Fit workflow on folds

```{r}
rf_fit <- rf_wkf %>% tune_grid(resamples = bike_10_fold, 
                                 grid = 10)

rf_best_params <- select_best(rf_fit, metric = "rmse")

rf_final_wkf <- rf_wkf %>% finalize_workflow(rf_best_params)
rf_final_fit <- rf_final_wkf %>% last_fit(bike_split, metrics = metric_set(rmse, mae))
```


## Finding best model in each of other models

# Comparing all of the best models

```{r}
rbind(
  mlr_final %>%
    collect_metrics() %>%
    mutate(Model = "MLR", .before = ".metric"), 
  tree_final_fit %>%
    collect_metrics() %>% 
    mutate(Model = "TREE", .before = ".metric"),
  bag_final_fit %>%
    collect_metrics() %>% 
    mutate(Model = "BAG", .before = ".metric"),
  rf_final_fit %>%
    collect_metrics() %>% 
    mutate(Model = "RF", .before = ".metric")  
)
```

Looks like the rf model has the lowest rmse, we'll use that model to fit the entire dataset then.

## Some more summaries of the models

### Mlr coeff

```{r}
mlr_final %>%
  extract_workflow() %>%
  extract_fit_parsnip() %>%
  tidy()
```

### Reg plot of final fit

```{r}
tree_final_fit |>
  extract_fit_engine() |>
  rpart.plot::rpart.plot(roundint = FALSE)
```

### Bagged Variable Importance plot

```{r}
bag_final_model <- extract_fit_engine(bag_final_fit)
bag_final_model$imp |>
  mutate(term = factor(term, levels = term)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = term, y = value)) +
  geom_bar(stat ="identity") +
  coord_flip()
```

### RF Variable Importance plot, just used a similar thing to above, could not understand how to use the stack version


```{r}
rf_model <- extract_fit_engine(rf_final_fit)

rf_imp <- tibble(term = names(rf_model$variable.importance), value = unname(rf_model$variable.importance))

rf_imp %>%
  mutate(term = factor(term, levels = term[order(value, decreasing = TRUE)])) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = term, y = value)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  coord_flip()
```



# Fitting the best of the best to full dataset

```{r}
rf_final_model_full <- rf_final_wkf %>%
  fit(data = bike_data_final)

rf_model_full <- extract_fit_engine(rf_final_model_full)
```

```{r}
rf_imp_full <- tibble(term = names(rf_model_full$variable.importance), value = unname(rf_model_full$variable.importance))

rf_imp_full %>%
  mutate(term = factor(term, levels = term[order(value, decreasing = TRUE)])) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = term, y = value)) +

  coord_flip()
```
